notes.title: EONIA Revelations announcement!
notes.content:
[p]EONIA Revelations is a first-person adventure that blends the beauty of fantasy with the fascination of science fiction.
It boasts a strong narrative, featuring engaging books, deep and varied dialogues, and plenty of humor thanks to the inimitable Lanio Landelion!
Different types of fonts and sounds vividly portray personalities, creating deep immersion.
You will explore a vast and colorful world filled with animals and characters that bring it to life with coherence. Everything has a purpose, and the rich, expansive lore ties it all together.
The search for animals, plants, and minerals will keep you occupied for hours while the mystery and secrets of the world conspire in the shadows, and before you know it, you’ll be the main protagonist of this story.
EONIA Revelations is not just a game; it’s an immersive journey into a beautiful world where every discovery brings you one step closer to revelation.
Are you ready to unravel the secrets?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Soon there will be news about the first demo for you to try![/p][p]Add the game to your wishlist on Steam and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487710/EONIA_Revelations/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]All the best to you, Knowledge Seekers.[/p][p]GEOMETRIC BYTES.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32531663/168095724425d9e87c8efe4a162821222210d2bb.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: EONIA NEW GAME MODE
notes.content:
Finishing EONIA has been and continues to be hard work. From the first moment, my idea for the game was to make it as big as possible, full of content, stories, and many activities to do. Of course, the game has all of these! But I wanted much more! Something extremely difficult to carry out being the only developer and in a time different than a lifetime. So, as always happens, reality had other plans for this first installment.
The game currently has four regions out of the twelve projected. Which haven’t been left out, far from it! Because maybe some of them will appear in a future massive update like the one released today. But if not, all of these, and many more!, will arrive in the next step of EONIA's history.
I am very proud of the current dimension of the game. It has about six km2 of territory and many things to do, with an estimated playtime of over twenty hours! If you like to explore and discover every nook and cranny of a new world, EONIA is without a doubt for you and will always have a prize for your curiosity. Let us not forget what Master Enodio always says: "The one who seeks, shall find a reward."
So here we are. With eight regions with arid zones, swamps, mushroom meadows, deserts with strange ruins, forests of giant trees and plains with nomads to name a few biomes and with almost twenty km2 of a fascinating and vibrant world that has not come to light. With hundreds of objects without being known, with +50 creatures to be amazed and with all kinds of structures such as the Smithy, the Alchemy Laboratory, the Mineral Warehouse, farms with all kinds of vegetables, dams and giant bridges and even much more.
I almost forget it! It also includes the combat system with swords, shields, and different types of spears! An experience that, for reasons of narrative, as I did not feel comfortable with Albius frantically murdering everything in his path, I have decided not to incorporate it to the final version.
So ... what if this world comes to light? How about I give you a chance to get an early glimpse of how everything in EONIA was born? The first design of this intriguing world. The first steps. How vast it is. The behind the scenes of the development of a video game. The tricks that are used to perform actions and skip events. In short, everything that is an essential part of a video game and that, for obvious reasons, is never visible or disappears directly as development progresses.
Personally, I thought it was an excellent idea. A recognition to you who have always supported me. That you have given me the immense pleasure of playing something that I have created. That I have imagined with all my love. I am infinitely grateful to you and, as a small acknowledgment, I let you explore the intimacy of EONIA.

Thank you so much for your continued support and for playing EONIA!

Regards to all,
H Juan M Silvetti, GEOMETRIC BYTES

notes.title: EONIA INFO
notes.content:
Hello, after thinking for a long time I have decided that it is best to divide EONIA into four chapters.
Being a huge game that will have +40 hours of gameplay and being a solo developer, it is taking me longer than I thought, and seeing that the game is very polished and with +10 hours of play I have made this decision.
The new chapters will not come out as early access, but as a finished game; and I make clear that those who have already bought the game, the same as those who did before the second chapter was released, will receive all the new content for free.
The main reason for this decision is the fact that many players do not buy games in early access thinking they have problems and bugs. But I believe it is not the case of EONIA, and I hope this encourages you to buy the game and join this adventure. No doubt a very valuable help.
Thank you for understanding and any questions you may have with pleasure I will answer them.

Juan.

notes.title: ALL GRAPHICS REVAMPED!!!
notes.content:
Version 0.50.004/2702

Massive update in EONIA as regards graphics, assets and art in general. New rocks! New trees! New buildings!
My original idea was to make the art of EONIA as simple as possible. No effects. No details. Only the simple texture wrapping everything. But then I wanted to try something different and, from my humble opinion, now it looks better than ever.
From now on, the graphics of EONIA -without losing its characteristic hand painted style of course- will feature bump mapping, metallic and every possible effect. This way, each object will look more vivid and I hope you will like this change as much as I do.
Of course, this is a big modification in a game of the magnitude of EONIA, so naturally, to update all the world will take some time. But the result will be delightful! Thank you, as always, for all the support you give me every day! Regards, Juan.

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!!!
notes.content:
I want to take this opportunity to greet and wish a good year to all those who shared this great dream of the birth of EONIA. This 2018 was the year of the begginig of a huge adventure as the emergence of an imperishable sadness. My sister has left us, and now she rests in the most beautiful place in the universe, and a dream has also been born, EONIA. 
Thanks to all who have trusted me. My heart will never forget them. Thanks to everyone who supported me. My heart will always have a special place for you. Good year! I wish you the best! You are a part of me! Thanks, with all my heart, 

Juan

notes.title: NPC!!! UPDATE PATCH 0.30.020/2708
notes.content:
EONIA is growing rapidly. This new update is crucial in the history of the game, since it integrates the NPCs. Even though I had to dismiss the initial idea that the Eonios are anthropomorphic beings for various reasons, I am more than satisfied with the new direction decided, and I hope you like the new inhabitants of this wonderful world. EONIA will never feel lonely again!
The game will have almost 100 NPCs. Living in towns, cities and, who knows where! A whole world full of life!
Thus we will meet with the dear Master Enodio, with Lanius, the faithful friend of Albius, with the eight Master Explorers, with the unique and perfect Artist, Writer and Inventor Mivos Esterus, with the alchemist, the botanist, the zoologist, the blacksmith, the carpenter, the musicians, the poets, the sculptors, the jeweler, the farmer, the postmen, and many others who carried out dozens of activities. Also, there are those that will be essential to the story and those who will only tell us the tales, legends and stories, or simply give us a greeting. But that will not prevent them from being intriguing or interesting.
There will be dozens of merchants with whom we can buy, sell and even exchange the most varied items! Without forgetting the mysterious Nomads! That will travel the roads from site to site. And of course, the ... well, I do not want to spoil the surprise.
There is still a long way to go. But little by little EONIA is transforming into that dream that I want to come true. It is an arduous journey, yes, but also fun and very enjoyable thanks to your constant support. Thank you for joining me in this adventure. Thanks for playing EONIA.

notes.title: GAMEPLAY UPDATE PATCH 0.25.115/1408
notes.content:
I have finished shaping the gameplay of this new EONIA, and I have also rethought about the types of ingredients that are obtained from animals. An also adding new missions and many improvements!

Regarding the gameplay, I made important changes to the "The pass is blocked off" mission, so that it matches with the new idea of the game and with the changes made in the previous big update. From now on, the Ampala will no longer be killed by the beetle, but fled in terror at his presence. Besides, as a new addition, it will be noted that the Jovaris now rest passively at the entrance of their cave once the invader leaves.

There is a redesign of the ingredients that were already in the game and there are several new ones. Now the fish will get scales, eggs and more. You can also find ingredients from both the Ampala and the Jovaris that you will find useful to make potions in a nearby update, among other things.

New mission (WIP)! If you have the soul of a hunter, you are in luck. It is known that ingredients can be obtained from every EONIA living being. But how to do it if it is not possible to kill them? Simple! Trapping them! Now you can build cages and attract those animals with an appetizing bait! Even the big and dangerous ones! But, of course, first you will have to learn how to build those cages with the help of Master Hunter, and also to know which is the preferred food of that creature you want to catch. For this, it will be necessary to draw it, compare it in one of the many Bestiariums, learn in this way what bait it is necessary and collect it in the wide areas of the world and then put it in the cage, that you  learned to make and build with wood, nails and other necessary materials that you had to gather, and finally capture your prey. After obtaining what you need from it, without forgetting that to collect certain ingredients will be necessary jars and some special tools, you will release it to wander free and be useful again after a while. Infinite ingredients! Sure, with a little patience.

New task! Is it monotonous to have to use the boat constantly to go to the island of the fishing pier? Now you can repair a direct path, so you do not have to repeat it! As long as you have all the necessary materials, of course!

Thank you all for making it possible for EONIA to improve day by day! In the next big update, I hope to finish the long-delayed huge cave. As you know, something has happened in my life that has affected the development time of the game. But I’m back working full time and you will see updates and improvements quicker and with much and richer content. As an advance, I can anticipate you that soon you will be able to find the first enemies of the game. Those against whom you must fight with swords, shields, spears, traps, poisons and, well, I do not want to spoil the surprise! But those enemies only want to eliminate you from the surface of the known world. So, have no mercy with them!
I cannot wait to show you all this and much more! I hope you like this update, and I would appreciate if you told me what you think about this. EONIA is very special to me, and I hope that, in one way or another, it can be for you too. Thanks, and regards!


MAIN CHANGES & ADDITIONS

- Lots of spelling corrections.
- Lots of improvements and fixes.
- Quest fixes and improvements.
- Performance improvements.
- Terrain fixes and improvements.
- Changes and improvements in the landscape.
- UI fixes and improvements.
- In the sheet of each skill in the Skill Tree, it indicates if it was already learned or not.
- All animals have their name.
- New quests!
- New task!
- New ingredients! (Jovari poop! But do not forget to grab it with a jar! And cover your nose!)
- Redesign of some ingredients.
- The name of the jars has been changed. Its usefulness has been expanded.
- and more!!!


I really appreciate your feedback! If you would find any issue, please don’t hesitate to let me know as soon as possible so that I can fix it. Thanks!

My sister has left us and now rests in the most beautiful place in the universe. Because without doubt someone like her has earned it. She has left us two precious girls that will give us the strength to continue and we will never forget her. I'm going to take a few days to assimilate this painful loss and next week I will get back to work full time with EONIA. A game that has been with me for some time and that is now more special than ever. I hope you’ll be able to understand it and thank you for all the support received.

notes.title: Very sad news.
notes.content: I was thinking whether to communicate this or not. It is very hard for me and I would have liked that this medium was only about fun and joy. But life has its ways we understand them or not. Sadly, my sister has cancer and she has very little time left. She is 39 years old and has two daughters (6 & 11). Almost a week ago I have not been able to devote myself as I would like to the game and I estimate that for a few more days this will continue the same. I just wanted you to know that I am committed to the game like the first day and I did not want to worry those, even though they are not the many I would have wanted, who have trusted and enjoy the game every day. I only ask you a few more days to cope with this terrible shock and I promise to return as strong as ever, to make Eonia the game I have been promising and waiting for. All of you are very important to me and very supportive. Thanks, and regards.

notes.title: Big gameplay changes and new content coming to EONIA!!!
notes.content:
[b]Regarding new stuff.[/b]

Hi! I'm planning big changes for EONIA coming in the next days. From now on there will be a Skill Tree, where you can see what skills Albius already has and which ones he must learn. Each skill, such as using swords, shields and spears, repairing weapons and tools, repairing/building structures, pruning trees, extracting minerals, making potions, opening locks, sailing by boat, and others, will have three levels of learning. The basic, the middle and the advanced. Of course, each one carrying a significant improvement over the previous one.

[b]Regarding changes in the gameplay.[/b]

It will no longer be necessary to read a book for using the different axes and pickaxes. Neither the hammer, but, as the hammer is used to repair/build structures, its use will depend on learning through reading the book "The Art of Construction". There are three variants of this book that will make it possible to repair/build basic, medium and large structures. But both axes and pickaxes can be used from the first moment to prune trees, break woods and extract minerals. But, obviously, at the beginning it will be in a basic level. Therefore, the tool will be damaged faster and less materials will be obtained. But these skills can be improved by readings books until reaching the advanced level, where the damage caused to the tool will be reduced considerably, and more material will be extracted in each stroke. All these can be followed in the new Skill Tree.
Also, from now on, plants and ingredients of animals, creatures and beasts can be collected. It is not required that Albius learns about them because Master Enodio has already taught him. The Botanical Knife and the Hunting Knife will be available from the beginning of the game. Each plant, ingredient and even minerals collected will appear in the inventory, but its characteristics will not be known until the corresponding Master, be it the Botanic Master, the Zoologist or the Geologist, help you discover their properties. Once done so, you will know their qualities, and they can be useful in the creation of potions, the charge of magic spheres and other activities. Or also sell them to merchants in exchange for something you need.

[b]Regarding new content.[/b]

You can build the damaged bridge that leads to the sand part, being able to visit it, and both the old Alorium mine and the cave in front of the Albius house will be available. There you will discover new missions, creatures, a basic shield and wooden spears to be used in ranged attacks. You will also be able to kill new creatures and obtain more ingredients.

[b]Final note[/b]

The game will be updated as quickly as possible and will evolve and grow day by day. Also improving, as it has already done, thanks to your valuable help. I hope you are as excited as I am for the new content, thanks for playing EONIA, thank you for trusting the game and regards to all. 

Have a wonderful day!
H Juan M Silvetti - GEOMETRIC BYTES

notes.title: Welcome to EONIA!!!
notes.content:
Hi.
I am the developer of EONIA and I am writing to announce the launch of the game in Early Access.

It's been a little over two years since the first sketches of the game were born and I decided to embark on this fascinating journey. One in which to make the soul of the beloved adventure games fit in an extensive open world full of life, mysteries and legends. All this immersed in a rich and extensive narrative. In a wonderful history of struggle, friendship and achievements.
It may seem that I have gone a long way. But this has not yet come to an end, and that is why I have decided to launch the game in Early Access.

I know there could be problems, errors and flaws here and there. That I will try to decrease as fast as possible. But I am alone immersed in this, and that is why I need to count on you to play it, enjoy it, and help me make EONIA become the exciting world that it should be. In that beautiful and fantastic place where the history of Albius takes place. A small explorer thirsty for adventure.

I am open to listen to all the opinions and advice that you want to give me. To thereby ensure that the game has the quality it deserves, and that you deserve.

There is nothing that I want more that EONIA entertains you, excites you and remains in your memory forever. I cannot wait for the incredible EONIA world to be as special for you as it is for me, and I look forward for you to join me on this exciting journey. Whose sole purpose is to create the best game that I can provide you. The one we all always want.

From my side, I will be grateful forever. I hope you will also be thankful with me for having make you part of the stories of a beautiful world that you will always embrace and never forget. Together we can make EONIA a great game. One that we always want to return to.

Kindest regards, and welcome to the adventure.
H Juan M Silvetti, GEOMETRIC BYTES
